nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) holding token balances of the ERC20/ReceiptToken contract.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) holding spending allowances.
Private uint256 holding the total supply of receipt tokens.
Private mapping(bytes32 => RoleData) storing role membership sets and admin roles.
Public mint(address to, uint256 amount): requires the caller to hold MINTER_ROLE then calls _mint.
Public burn(address from, uint256 amount): requires the caller to hold BURNER_ROLE then calls _burn.
Internal _mint(address account, uint256 amount): increases _totalSupply and _balances[account] using SafeMath.add.
Internal _burn(address account, uint256 amount): decreases _balances[account] and _totalSupply using SafeMath.sub.
Public view hasRole(bytes32 role, address account): reads _roles[role].members and returns membership.
Public virtual grantRole(bytes32 role, address account): admin-gated role granting entry point.
Public virtual revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account): admin-gated role revocation entry point.
Public transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount): moves tokens from _msgSender() to recipient.
Public transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount): moves tokens and updates allowance.
Internal _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount): updates _balances of sender and recipient.
Internal _approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount): writes _allowances and emits Approval.
Caller-controlled msg.sender, used both for MINTER_ROLE/BURNER_ROLE checks and as the token source in transfer/approve.
_balances[account] = _balances[account].add(amount) inside _mint: unchecked arithmetic sink requiring SafeMath overflow protection.
_totalSupply = _totalSupply.add(amount) inside _mint: unchecked arithmetic sink requiring SafeMath overflow protection.
Low-level external call recipient.call{value: amount}("") that transfers ETH with all available gas and can re-enter the caller.
Internal sendValue(address payable recipient, uint256 amount): require balance check then low-level value call.
address to: recipient of freshly minted receipt tokens.
uint256 amount: quantity of receipt tokens minted.
address from: account whose receipt tokens are burned.
uint256 amount: quantity of receipt tokens burned.
address account: destination of the minted balance inside _mint.
uint256 amount: value added to balance and total supply inside _mint.
address account: source of the burned balance inside _burn.
uint256 amount: value subtracted from balance and total supply inside _burn.
bytes32 role: role identifier being queried in hasRole.
address account: member address being queried in hasRole.
address sender: debited account in _transfer.
address recipient: credited account in _transfer.
uint256 amount: value moved between balances in _transfer.

edges.reason: mint's `to` parameter flows into the mint entry point body.
mint's `amount` parameter flows into the mint entry point body.
burn's `from` parameter flows into the burn entry point body.
burn's `amount` parameter flows into the burn entry point body.
mint forwards its `to` argument to _mint(to, amount).
mint forwards its `amount` argument into _mint's addition of balance and total supply.
burn forwards its `from` argument to _burn(from, amount).
burn forwards its `amount` argument into _burn's subtraction of balance and total supply.
mint checks hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, msg.sender), so the caller identity gates minting.
burn checks hasRole(BURNER_ROLE, msg.sender), so the caller identity gates burning.
transfer credits/debits using _msgSender() which resolves to msg.sender.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() for the allowance owner check.
mint reverts unless hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, msg.sender) returns true.
burn reverts unless hasRole(BURNER_ROLE, msg.sender) returns true.
hasRole reads the _roles[role].members set from storage.
grantRole reads and mutates _roles[role].adminRole and members.
mint invokes the internal _mint after the role check.
burn invokes the internal _burn after the role check.
_mint executes _balances[account].add(amount) addition.
_mint executes _totalSupply.add(amount) addition.
The addition result is written back into the _balances state variable.
The addition result is written back into the _totalSupply state variable.
_burn subtracts and writes the new value into _balances[account].
_burn subtracts and writes the new value into _totalSupply.
_mint's `account` parameter selects the balance slot to credit.
_mint's `amount` parameter is the addend for both arithmetic sinks.
_burn's `account` parameter selects the balance slot to debit.
_burn's `amount` parameter is the subtrahend for both arithmetic sinks.
hasRole's `role` parameter indexes _roles.
hasRole's `account` parameter is the membership key being tested.
transfer delegates the balance mutation to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the balance mutation to _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
_transfer performs unchecked subtraction/addition on _balances for sender and recipient.
_approve writes the allowance value into the _allowances state variable.
_transfer's `sender` parameter is the debited balance owner.
_transfer's `recipient` parameter is the credited balance owner.
_transfer's `amount` parameter feeds the balance arithmetic.
sendValue performs the low-level value call that transfers control to the recipient.
The external call can re-enter the calling contract (callback) before state finalization, creating a reentrancy path.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter `to` of mint is normalized into the _mint core function that consumes it as the balance recipient.
Parameter `amount` of mint is normalized into _mint, where it feeds the arithmetic sinks.
Parameter `from` of burn is normalized into the _burn core function that debits the account.
Parameter `amount` of burn is normalized into _burn, where it feeds the subtraction sink.
Parameter `account` of _mint is normalized into _mint's balance credit operation.
Parameter `amount` of _mint is normalized into _mint's addition operations.
Parameter `account` of _burn is normalized into _burn's balance debit operation.
Parameter `amount` of _burn is normalized into _burn's subtraction operations.
Parameter `role` of hasRole is normalized into the hasRole access-control query.
Parameter `account` of hasRole is normalized into the hasRole access-control query.
Parameter `sender` of _transfer is normalized into the _transfer balance mutation.
Parameter `recipient` of _transfer is normalized into the _transfer balance mutation.
Parameter `amount` of _transfer is normalized into the _transfer arithmetic operation.
